# PR #3801: Patch: the AI weighs all three of Mind Games' secret choices instead of always keeping the first

Closes #3772

## What changed

The AI now compares all three Mind Games choices instead of always keeping the first. With the enemy hero in Attack's reach it keeps Attack, and when it must survive it keeps Defend.

**Why it happened.** One cast of Mind Games gives the search three follow-up positions, one per choice (Greed, Attack, Defend). They differed only in the secret record the cast stores, and `search_signature` never read `state.secrets`. So all three got the same signature, and both the beam's duplicate check and the lethal solver's visited set kept only the first one, Greed.

**The fix** (`crates/ai/src/simulate.rs`, `search_signature`). When a position holds a secret, its signature gets one more part, `S…`. For each record it holds the owner, the choice (`-` where `redact` dropped it) and an `r` if it is revealed, sorted, and without the id the engine minted for it. A position with no secret (`None` or an empty list) signs exactly as before. `search.rs`, `lethal.rs` and `unstoppable.rs` all key on this function, so they pick up the change without edits.

**Hidden information.** The AI only ever searches `redact`ed states and the worlds `determinize` samples from them. In those states the opponent's unrevealed choice is either gone or a random sample, so signing it reveals nothing. `observe.rs` is unchanged.

**Spec.**
- A new ruling note, `spec/rulings/R3772000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/3772.md`.
- One sentence added to §9.9's **Search** bullet.
- One clause added to the Mind Games row in §8 (M #22).
- One sentence added to `crates/ai/README.md`.

`spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md` are not touched.

## Tests

New tests in `crates/ai/tests/ai/position_model.rs`, in `mod signature`:
- The three choices sign apart from each other and from a position with no secret.
- The minted id is not signed.
- The owner, the revealed flag and a dropped choice each change the signature.
- Two secrets sign the same in either order and with different ids.
- An empty list of secrets signs the same as none.
- `"S"` is added to the parts that `a_plain_position_signs_none_of_the_new_parts` checks are absent.

New tests in `crates/ai/tests/ai/secrets.rs`:
- Two states that differ only in the opponent's unrevealed choice sign differently as they are, and alike once redacted.
- The beam keeps all three choices as first actions.
- `decide` keeps Attack when its damage wins, on 4 of 4 seeds.
- `decide` keeps Defend when it must survive, on 4 of 4 seeds.

Commands I ran and what they printed:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r3772000`: 9 passed. With `simulate.rs` put back to the base version, 6 of those 9 failed, the ones the plan marks as failing without the fix. The fix was then restored.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`: 825, 98 and 36 passed, 0 failed; the 7 ignored are the existing daily sweeps.
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: `1915 rulings, 4967 proofs, 62660 citations in 4125 files, 25470 links: ok`.
- `cargo jackioh gate`: exit 0.
  - ai-vs-random: 19 of 20 won, 17 needed.
  - ai-vs-greedy: 16 of 20, 10 needed.
  - hard-vs-easy: 20 of 20, 16 needed.
  - No search panics.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: `Internal`, so no patch fragment is needed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools -p jackioh-shared -p jackioh-server --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: exit 0, 3935 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored. I ran these because those crates use the AI. Afterwards `git status -- apps/web/src/wire` showed no change.

I did not run the full `cargo test --workspace`, the web tests or fuzz; the harness and CI run those.

## Decisions the issue left open

All are recorded in the ruling note. The plan was followed as written.
- **Three real positions, not lane variants.** The issue offered #1797's lane-variant route as a fallback. I rejected it because a variant is never played further, and `AI_SEARCH.zone_variants` is 2, so it would keep only two of the three choices.
- **The lethal solver and the concession check see the secrets too.** I rejected leaving them out, so one signature means one thing everywhere. After a castable Mind Games, each of those walks now explores the three choices separately, which costs up to three times as much for that part of the tree, but each walk stays within its node budget. All existing `lethal*` and `unstoppable*` tests pass.
- **Owner and revealed flag are signed, not just the choice.** Without them, two secrets with different owners, or a revealed and an unrevealed one, would merge.
- **The optional exhaustive-destructuring guard test was not added.** It goes beyond what the issue requires.

## Worth a second look

- **Known limit, also in the note.** If no Mind Games line makes the six-line shortlist on its own, R3696000's single payoff line is still the first of the three, Greed. Fixing that would mean changing R3696000 in `decide.rs`; it could be a follow-up issue.
- **Test board choice.** On the `decide` boards, p2 holds a full hand of 10, so the Fortify Mind the cast hands it is burned. Otherwise the reply would play a guess on some sampled worlds and cancel the reward. The scenario's library sizes are as the plan pinned them: with 2 cards in p1's library, the survive board flipped to Attack.

## Goal

`search_signature` signs the secrets a Mind Games kept, so the three children of one cast (Greed, Attack, Defend) stay three positions. The beam then plays on and replies to all three: `decide` keeps Attack when its damage wins and Defend when it must survive. A position with no secret signs exactly as today. The opponent's unrevealed choice stays unread, because the AI searches only `redact`ed states. The minted id is not signed.

An earlier planning run built this exact change in a scratch copy of `386718245903`; only `crates/server` and unrelated spec notes have changed since, and each anchor below occurs once in the tree. With the fix, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, clippy, rustfmt, `gate` and `spec check` were green, and `decide` kept the right choice on 16 of 16 extra seeds per board. Without the fix, 6 of the 9 new tests failed. This plan replaces the one first posted on the issue, which cited R58 for the hand cap; it is R4 and R862.

   ```rust
       // R3772000: the secrets a Mind Games kept, by the same rule: each one's owner, choice and whether
       // it is revealed, sorted and without the id the engine minted it, so the three choices of one cast
       // stay three positions.
       if let Some(secrets) = &state.secrets
           && !secrets.is_empty()
       {
           let secrets = sorted(secrets.iter().map(|secret| {
               format!(
                   "{}:{}:{}",
                   secret.owner,
                   secret.choice.map_or("-", |choice| choice.as_str()),
                   if secret.revealed == Some(true) { "r" } else { "" }
               )
           }));
           parts.push(format!("S{secrets}"));
       }
   ```
